hero.headline: Grass-fed beef from Paraguay, sold at conventional prices.
hero.allianceNote: We’re building a 300,000-head producer alliance, and a full traceability layer behind it.

whatWeSellToday.body: Today we sell grass-fed Paraguayan beef under the MPCS standard, at conventional prices.
whatWeSellToday.noFullHistoryNote: A full, ear-tag-to-box traceable history isn’t available yet — we’re building that traceability layer now.

promise.body: We sell at conventional prices and compete on resilience and scale. The better product isn’t a way to charge more — it’s how we intend to shift what conventional beef looks like.

firstPick.body: Trade with us now, and you get first pick of the traceable, aligned supply as it comes online.

whySupplyDifferent.body: Beef from our own herds and from producer-alliance herds is raised under the same Code — supply we control and can vouch for, not just source and hope.

whoVerifies.codeReferenceNote: Every animal is raised, and every herd sold, under the Orbolo Code.
